cases.sentence: Иаков посмотрел и увидел, что идёт ___, и с ним четыреста человек.
cases.explain: Исав is the subject of the verb идёт ("is coming"), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Приближаясь к брату, он поклонился до ___ семь раз.
cases.explain: The preposition до ("to, as far as") governs the genitive case, hence земли.

cases.sentence: Сам же он пошёл вперёд и, приближаясь к ___, поклонился до земли семь раз.
cases.explain: The preposition к ("toward") requires the dative case, hence брату.

cases.sentence: Там он установил ___ и назвал его Бог, Бог Израиля.
cases.explain: The transitive verb установил ("set up") takes a direct object in the accusative case; for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative жертвенник has the same form as the nominative.

cases.sentence: Придя из Падан-Арама, Иаков поселился перед ___.
cases.explain: The preposition перед ("in front of / before") governs the instrumental case, hence городом.

cases.sentence: Мой господин знает, что дети слабы, и что я должен заботиться о дойных ___ и коровах.
cases.explain: The preposition о ("about, concerning") governs the prepositional case, hence овцах.

cases.sentence: Подошли служанки со своими ___ и поклонились.
cases.explain: The preposition со (a form of с, "with") governs the instrumental case, hence детьми.

reading.ru: Иаков посмотрел и увидел, что идет Исав, и с ним четыреста человек.
reading.question: How many men were with Esau when Jacob saw him approaching?
reading.explain: The text states that Esau was coming with four hundred men.

reading.ru: Он поставил служанок и их детей впереди.
reading.question: How did Jacob arrange his family as they went out to meet Esau?
options: He put the servants and their children in front, then Leah and her children, with Rachel and Joseph last
He put Rachel and Joseph in front, then Leah, then the servants
He sent Leah out first alone to meet Esau
He hid all the children behind the servants only
reading.correct: He put the servants and their children in front, then Leah and her children, with Rachel and Joseph last
reading.explain: The text says Jacob put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after them, and Rachel with Joseph at the rear.

reading.ru: Исав посмотрел, увидел женщин и детей и спросил, «Кто это с тобой?»
reading.question: What did Esau ask when he saw the women and children with Jacob?
reading.explain: Esau saw the women and children and asked, "Who are these with you?"

reading.ru: Иаков настаивал, и Исав принял дары.
reading.question: What happened after Jacob insisted that Esau take the gifts?
options: Esau gave the gifts back to Jacob's servants
reading.explain: The text says Jacob insisted, and Esau accepted the gifts.

reading.ru: Если их сильно гнать хотя бы один день, то животные погибнут.
reading.question: Why did Jacob say he needed to travel slowly with his group?
options: Because driving the flocks and children too hard for even one day would kill the animals
Because he was afraid of Esau's men
Because the road to Seir was blocked
Because Rachel was too tired to walk
reading.correct: Because driving the flocks and children too hard for even one day would kill the animals
reading.explain: Jacob explains that if the animals are driven hard even one day, they will die.

reading.ru: Иаков благополучно прибыл в город Шехем в Ханаане, придя из Падан-Арама и поселился перед городом.
reading.question: Where did Jacob settle after coming from Paddan Aram?
options: Near the city of Shechem in Canaan
In the land of Seir with Esau
reading.correct: Near the city of Shechem in Canaan
reading.explain: The text says Jacob arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped before the city.

reading.ru: Там он установил жертвенник и назвал его Бог, Бог Израиля.
reading.question: What did Jacob name the altar he built near Shechem?
reading.explain: The text says he set up an altar there and called it God, the God of Israel.
